name: Ananta Mulyono
intro: My work is about making complexity legible. I observe, ask questions, challenge assumptions, and bring structure across stakeholders, processes, and the design itself. I’m drawn to problems where the answer isn’t just on the screen, but in the people and context around it.

projects.title: Nationale Veteranendag
projects.text: For Nationale Veteranendag I applied a new campaign identity to the website, restructuring the information hierarchy to balance campaign messaging with veterans’ personal stories.

projects.title: Kinfill
projects.text: For Kinfill, a Rotterdam-based sustainable cleaning brand, I redesigned the website while a technical team improved performance and future-proofed their logistical processes.

projects.title: Eneco
projects.text: At Eneco I worked on the redesign and continued improvement of the sales flow, with additional contributions to the design system and UX operations.

projects.title: Riserve
projects.text: For Riserve I designed the website and UX flows for a platform connecting talent and jobs with a shared passion for football.

projects.title: Gemeente Den Haag
projects.text: At Gemeente Den Haag I work as a UX designer across research, content architecture, design, and project coordination for the people and businesses the city serves.

projects.title: bami.blog
projects.text: A logbook of instant noodles. Every pack gets a photo, a number, a flag and a rating out of five.

projects.title: CPC 10K
projects.text: A training app I built for myself on the way to the CPC Loop 10K in Den Haag: my plan week by week, runs pulled in from intervals.icu, and an AI coach that sums up every run and adjusts the tips for the next one.
